mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost (uid, pay_type, pay_money, pay_state, is_check, time) VALUES (#{uid}, #{payType}, #{payMoney}, #{payState}, #{isCheck}, #{time})
mapper.update: UPDATE cost SET uid = #{uid}, pay_type = #{payType}, pay_money = #{payMoney}, pay_state = #{payState}, is_check = #{isCheck} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cost.*, u.name, u.phone, u.room_number FROM cost LEFT JOIN room_user u ON cost.uid = u.id ORDER BY TIME DESC
SELECT cost.*, u.name, u.phone, u.room_number FROM cost LEFT JOIN room_user u ON cost.uid = u.id WHERE cost.id = #{costId} ORDER BY TIME DESC
SELECT cost.*, u.name, u.phone, u.room_number FROM cost LEFT JOIN room_user u ON cost.uid = u.id WHERE uid = #{uid} ORDER BY TIME DESC
